title: Starting and stopping on the server's beat
notes: In the private server trial with predicted movement, your wanderer now runs ahead of the server by the time a message takes to get there and back, so the server applies each step at the moment you took it.
Stopping no longer slides you back a short way after the server answers, and a server hiccup that skips time no longer makes every later stop overshoot and pull you back by a few metres.
This stays a preview for server trials only: it needs both WAR_ZONE_MOVEMENT=1 and WAR_PREDICTED_MOVEMENT=1. Ordinary launches move exactly as before.
